source.author: damezumari
source.text:
I am a bit older than you.

I think it is important to do what you feel is meaningful to you, either as a hobby, or at work. I was lucky enough to freelance consult long enough and invest extra money from it at a good time that I do not strictly speaking have to work anymore, but I enjoy it ( and my SO does not want me moping around the house all the time ) so I am in my 4th startup during last 3 years, still doing slightly unhealthy hours.

As you spend a lot of your waking life at work, having it be meaningful is probably the easiest solution. Failing that, doing something fun as a hobby, time permitting, or enjoying not doing anything could work as well although I have not succeeded at those as much.
